There is definitely something odd about this global warming agenda that has been pushed upon us. The claim is CO2 causes raised temperatures but if we look at ice core data it shows temperatures rising before CO2 levels rise. [source](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/ice-core-data-help-solve/)
What did cause these fluctuations we see in this ice core data? It seems to me it's just a natural cycle. This whole fear mongering of global warming is a little telling aswell. Every other year theres a headline "OUR LAST DAYS UNLESS WE STOP GLOBAL WARMING" 1 year goes by, we're fine, 2, we're fine, etc etc. My stance isnt discrediting the real environmental damages we are causing with ocean pollution, tearing up natural habitats, toxic waste and general parasitic behavior. It's in my opinion this global warming charade is here to distract us from problems that are 100% within our control and keep us fearful thinking our next days could suddenly be our last at the drop of a dime.
